# Maz — projects

This repository is the home: one place for everything, rather than a
repository per project. What was already here stayed exactly where it
was, and repositories folded in from elsewhere land in `projects/`
with their full history.

## Working in here

Each project is self-contained: its build, its tests and its README are
inside its own directory, and they work exactly as they did before.

Nothing above moved when this repository became the home, so every path,
build and command that worked before still works unchanged.

## Where this came from

See [CONSOLIDATION.md](CONSOLIDATION.md) for the original repository, branch
and commit behind every directory, and for how to pull in later changes.
